_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Device Sync Hub are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `vrooli scenario generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

join.title: Join this device
join.intro: Pair this browser with your hub to send and receive. Enter a pairing code, or request approval from a device that's already trusted.
join.requestIntro: Request approval instead. A trusted device gets a prompt to let you in.
join.waitingIntro: Your request was sent. Approve it from a device that's already trusted, then this screen continues automatically.

receive.heading: Receive
receive.empty: Nothing here yet. Send something from another device.

send.heading: Send
send.description: Drop files, pick files, or paste text.
send.textPlaceholder: Paste or type text to send…

devices.signInPrompt: Sign in as the owner to manage your devices.
devices.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? This severs its access immediately.

issue.heading: Add a device
issue.description: Issue a pairing code, then enter or scan it on the new device.
issue.codeHint: Enter this code on the new device, or scan the QR.

owner.intro: Owner actions (managing devices, issuing codes) need you to be signed in.

onboarding.welcomeIntro: Sync files and text across your devices. Set up this hub if it's new, or join one that already exists.

register.emailTaken: That email is already registered — switch to Sign in.

setupDevice.title: Make this your first device

setupDevice.alreadyOwned: This hub is already owned by another account. Sign in as that owner, or reset this local hub before setting it up with a new account.
